description: One miniapp's STORE PAGE: listing (title, subtitle, description, kind, category, tags, age, support_url, icon_url), current build (hash, version, size_bytes = what a player downloads, permissions against the known vocabulary, media = the gallery: the build's own preview images then its screenshot), every version with its release notes, rating {avg, count, hist[1★…5★]}, players_7d (distinct players over the last 7 UTC days, the author's own excluded), playing_now (live play sessions), and the developer. Public.
name: get_store_app
title: Get store page
